name: Emma Thompson
summary: An open-minded designer interested in accessible technology, Christian ethics and local cultural experiences.

preferences.definition: Willingness to consider different ideas, evidence, and perspectives.
An interest in asking questions and exploring new ideas to understand technology.
Principles used to consider what is right, responsible, and fair.
Communicating truthfully and accurately, including when it is difficult.
Discussing different views without insults, contempt, or dismissiveness.
An interest in noticing and learning about visual art, places, and experiences.
